outline:
本課程旨在講授互動媒體腳本廣告的規劃與製作原理，包括互動媒體的特性、廣告製作可如何掌握、發揮互動式媒體的特性，以及建置、設計、發展、與維護互動媒體所需的相關概念、科技與技能。本課程亦教導同學如何應用電腦影像（computer imaging）與多媒體的科技與技術，來製作互動媒體作品。
This course aims to introduce the principles of planning and producing interactive media advertising scripts. It covers the characteristics of interactive media, how to effectively manage and execute advertising production, and how to leverage the unique features of interactive media. Students will also learn the essential concepts, technologies, and skills required for the development, design, implementation, and maintenance of interactive media systems.
